full_judgment: 20.In reference No. 1 of 1965, P.143,1966 Karachi 160, the question of interpretation of section 83 of the Code of Civil Procedure came up for consideration. The Karachi Bench of the West Pakistan High Court, after considering a number of authorities and the Halsbury's Laws of England held that Pakistan nationals residing in India at the time of emergency were alien enemies, and the suit then pending in Pakistan Courts could not proceed without the sanction of the Central Government. Regarding 'resident' it has been clearly observed that it must be voluntary and that the prisoner of war is not an alien enemy.
